hypotheses.justification: The conclusion t ∉ secQ K1 K2 only needs secQ K1 K2 ≤ L, together with t ∉ L from hb (hb G t L S z hctx.toSec10Z, whose third component is t ∉ L). The existing proof gets this via sec10J_Q_le, which uses hP5 only for the normalizer/Sylow argument showing secQ ≤ S ⊓ L. The weaker inclusion secQ K1 K2 ≤ L ⊓ centralizer {z} is derived inside sec10J_Q_le (hKY, hQY) from hctx.pocket1.2.1 and hctx.pocket2.2.1 plus Subgroup.map_subtype_le (pCore 2 ↥(K1 ⊔ K2)) (secQ ≤ K1 ⊔ K2), and none of that uses hP5. So the proof becomes: take htnotL from hb, assume t ∈ secQ K1 K2, then t ∈ L ⊓ centralizer {z} by hQY, so t ∈ L, contradicting htnotL. The statement is therefore true and provable without hP5, with no degenerate-case issues. I could not run Lean, so I did not compile the revised proof.
